name: Agent Content Kind
description: The class of information an agent content entry carries: what an agent needs to store, retrieve, or search against across sessions. Classification describes the content; it does not establish who may write it or confer authority.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: The kind has not been determined. Writers must not store an entry under this value; readers treat it as unclassified.

values.label: Checkpoint
values.description: A seat's resumable working state at a point in time (agent-state). Append-only lane history.

values.label: Identity
values.description: Who a seat is and the estate it operates in. Maintainer-provisioned; read-only to agents.

values.label: Charter
values.description: A seat's standing mandate, scope, and orientation for new sessions. Maintainer-authored.

values.label: Week
values.description: Goals and commitments for a calendar week.

values.label: Day
values.description: Plan and outcomes for one working day.

values.label: Handoff
values.description: Work passed from one seat or session to another, with its acknowledgement.

values.label: Decision note
values.description: A decision taken, with its rationale and evidence. Attestation required.

values.label: Learned fact
values.description: One observed, told, or inferred fact a seat should carry forward, with confidence and a review date.

values.label: Reference
values.description: A pointer to an external document by location and content digest, with the actions it applies to. Never a copy.

values.label: Credential reference
values.description: Where a credential lives and how to unlock it. Never holds the credential value.

values.label: Blob
values.description: An opaque, size-capped binary or text body referenced by digest.

examples.dataset: a seat's resumable state written at session end
a note that a CI gate needs a clean tree
the location and unlock steps for an org access token
